races.display_title: Coral 'Black Friday Price Boosts' 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: PRINCE RUPERT looked something out of the ordinary when making a winning bumper debut at Kempton back in March, a race Nicky Henderson landed with Shishkin a few years earlier. He's an exciting prospect now hurdling with his yard boasting a fine record in this race. Unsurprisingly there is depth in opposition, with dangers headed up by fellow impressive bumper winner River Kwai . Ffos Las second Oatsoeasy and Lover Desbois complete the shortlist. races.display_title: Coral 'Pipped-At-The-Post' And Win Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: Winner of a point and his hurdling debut, WESTERN MONKEY shaped well after 11 months off when finishing mid-field over this C&D 22 days ago and he can build on his reappearance effort to resume winning ways. Heading the list of dangers is Harbour Light as he bids for a 5-timer, while Lihyan is another to consider from a handy mark. WESTERN MONKEY HARBOUR LIGHT LIHYAN (IRE)

races.display_title: Midnite Golden Rose Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict: CRESTOFDISTINCTION arrives at the top of his game and is 2 from 2 on all-weather, so has plenty going for him. Soldier's Tree is the obvious threat if back to the level he showed when placed in the Wokingham, while Ain't Nobody responded very well to the switch to all-weather when just failing in a Group 3 at Dundalk and is also respected in what is a strong listed event. CRESTOFDISTINCTION SOLDIER'S TREE (IRE) AIN'T NOBODY (IRE)
